message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, not the King Fahd Bridge.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.", "reason": "The Wikipedia page directly documents the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, confirming the event referenced in the note as the actual source of the video."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, not the King Fahd Bridge.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia page directly documents the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, confirming the event referenced in the note as the actual source of the video.
